# 1. Imports

```{r imports}
base <- "C:/Users/nbo15/Documents/EPFL/Master/EPFL_Semestre_1_documents/MSR/Project/"

fishdata              <- read.csv(paste0(base, "Catoctin_FishData.csv"))

loggersites           <- read.csv(paste0(base, "Catoctin_LoggerSites.csv"))
```

# 2. Fish data: reach x species matrix

```{r fish-matrix}
# Count filled          -> keep the total
# Count empty + Length  -> 1 measured fish (trout SATR / SAFO)
# Count empty, Length empty (2 rows of FOM27) -> 0
fishdata_modified <- fishdata %>%
  mutate(Count = case_when(!is.na(Count)  ~ as.numeric(Count),
                           !is.na(Length) ~ 1,
                           TRUE           ~ 0))

wide <- fishdata_modified %>%
  select(ReachID, Species, Count) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = Count,
              values_fn = sum, values_fill = 0) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(wide) <- wide$ReachID
wide <- wide %>% select(-ReachID)
sp_names <- colnames(wide)

dim(wide)
sort(colSums(wide), decreasing = TRUE)      # total abundance per species
sort(colSums(wide > 0), decreasing = TRUE)  # number of reaches where present
```

```{r heatmap}
BC.fishdata <- vegdist(wide, method = "bray")
heatmap(as.matrix(BC.fishdata))
```

# 3. Habitat data: cleaning and reach-level variables

```{r habitat-clean}
habitat <- fishhabitat
habitat <- habitat[, names(habitat) != ""]          # last empty columns

habitat <- habitat %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ toupper(trimws(.x)))) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Mesohabitat"), ~ recode(.x, "R5U" = "RUN")),
         across(starts_with("Substrate"),
                ~ recode(.x, "MO" = "MOSS", "S" = NA_character_, "RO" = NA_character_)),
         DepthL = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(DepthL)))
```

```{r habitat-variables}
# Width: mean and coefficient of variation per reach
width <- habitat %>%
  mutate(WettedWidth = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(WettedWidth))) %>%
  group_by(ReachID) %>%
  summarise(width_mean = mean(WettedWidth, na.rm = TRUE),
            width_sd   = sd(WettedWidth,   na.rm = TRUE),
            width_cv   = width_sd / width_mean,
            .groups = "drop")

# Depth: all Depth* columns pooled (L, M, R if present)
depth <- habitat %>%
  select(ReachID, starts_with("Depth")) %>%
  mutate(across(-ReachID, ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ReachID, values_to = "depth") %>%
  group_by(ReachID) %>%
  summarise(depth_mean = mean(depth, na.rm = TRUE),
            depth_cv   = sd(depth, na.rm = TRUE) / depth_mean,
            .groups = "drop")

# Water temperature: mean per reach
temp_reach <- habitat %>%
  mutate(Temp = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Temp))) %>%
  group_by(ReachID) %>%
  summarise(MeanTempC = mean(Temp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# % pools / riffles / runs
meso <- habitat %>%
  select(ReachID, MesohabitatL, MesohabitatM, MesohabitatR) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ReachID, values_to = "meso") %>%
  filter(!is.na(meso)) %>%
  count(ReachID, meso) %>%
  group_by(ReachID) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = meso, values_from = pct,
              names_prefix = "pct_", values_fill = 0)

# % of each substrate (Top + Bottom pooled)
# surface only -> select(ReachID, starts_with("SubstrateTop"))
substrate <- habitat %>%
  select(ReachID, starts_with("SubstrateTop"), starts_with("SubstrateBottom")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ReachID, values_to = "substrate") %>%
  filter(!is.na(substrate)) %>%
  count(ReachID, substrate) %>%
  group_by(ReachID) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = substrate, values_from = pct,
              names_prefix = "sub_", values_fill = 0)

```

```{r merge}
env <- width %>%
  select(-width_sd) %>%
  left_join(depth,      by = "ReachID") %>%
  left_join(temp_reach, by = "ReachID") %>%
  left_join(meso,       by = "ReachID") %>%
  left_join(substrate,  by = "ReachID")

# FULL DATA: fish + environment
full_data <- wide %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("ReachID") %>%
  left_join(env, by = "ReachID")

# reaches with fish data but no habitat survey
setdiff(rownames(wide), habitat$ReachID)
```

# 4. Water temperature map

```{r temp-map}
lat_col_fish <- "Latitude"
lon_col_fish <- "Longitude"

fish_temp_array <- fishsites_coordinates |>
  left_join(temp_reach, by = setNames("ReachID", id_col_fish)) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c(lon_col_fish, lat_col_fish), crs = 4326)

map_fish_temp <- ggplot() +
  annotation_map_tile(type = "osm", zoom = 14) +
  geom_sf(data = fish_temp_array, aes(fill = MeanTempC),
          shape = 21, size = 3.5, color = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_sf_text(data = fish_temp_array, aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", MeanTempC)),
               size = 2.3, nudge_y = 0.0015, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Mean water\ntemp. (°C)",
                       na.value = "grey70") +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl") +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "tr", style = north_arrow_minimal()) +
  labs(title = "Water temperature at fish sampling sites, Catoctin Mountain Park",
       subtitle = "Mean of transect measurements, July 2015",
       caption = "Grey: no habitat survey.",
       x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme_bw()
map_fish_temp
# ggsave("map_fish_temp.png", map_fish_temp, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 600)
```

# 5. Dendrograms

```{r dendrograms}
k <- 3
pal <- c("#E41A1C", "#0000FF", "#FF00FF", "#834333", "#008000")

# remove empty reaches
fish_raw <- wide[rowSums(wide) > 0, ]
fish_hell <- decostand(fish_raw, "hellinger")

# coordinates matched by ReachID (no assumption on row order)
sites <- fishsites_coordinates[match(rownames(fish_raw), fishsites_coordinates[, 1]), ]
stopifnot(!anyNA(sites[, 1]))

get_hc <- function(mat) hclust(vegdist(mat, "euc"), method = "ward.D2")
hc_raw  <- get_hc(fish_raw)
hc_hell <- get_hc(fish_hell)
grp_raw  <- cutree(hc_raw,  k)
grp_hell <- cutree(hc_hell, k)

all(names(grp_raw)  == sites[, 1])
all(names(grp_hell) == sites[, 1])

plot_dendro <- function(hc, grp, titre) {
  plot(hc, labels = FALSE, hang = -1, main = titre,
       xlab = "", sub = "", ylab = "Height (Ward.D2)")
  # rect.hclust numbers clusters left to right -> map to cutree IDs (same colours as maps)
  ids_lr <- unique(grp[hc$order])
  rect.hclust(hc, k = k, border = pal[ids_lr])
  legend("topright", legend = paste("Group", 1:k), fill = pal[1:k], border = NA,
         bg = "white", cex = 0.8, inset = 0.02, xpd = TRUE)
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(2, 4, 3, 1))
plot_dendro(hc_raw,  grp_raw,  "No transformation")
plot_dendro(hc_hell, grp_hell, "Hellinger")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1)
```

```{r cluster-maps}
pts <- st_as_sf(data.frame(sites[, 2:3], grp_raw = grp_raw, grp_hell = grp_hell),
                coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)

bb <- st_bbox(pts)
marge <- 0.1
dx <- (bb["xmax"] - bb["xmin"]) * marge
dy <- (bb["ymax"] - bb["ymin"]) * marge
bb["xmin"] <- bb["xmin"] - dx; bb["xmax"] <- bb["xmax"] + dx
bb["ymin"] <- bb["ymin"] - dy; bb["ymax"] <- bb["ymax"] + dy

tiles <- get_tiles(st_as_sfc(bb), provider = "OpenTopoMap",
                   zoom = 14, crop = TRUE, project = FALSE)
pts_m <- st_transform(pts, crs(tiles))

plot_map <- function(group_col, titre) {
  plot_tiles(tiles)
  plot(st_geometry(pts_m), add = TRUE, pch = 16, cex = 1.5,
       col = pal[pts_m[[group_col]]])
  legend("topright", legend = paste("Group", 1:k), pch = 16, col = pal[1:k],
         bg = "white", box.col = "grey40", cex = 0.8, pt.cex = 1.2,
         inset = 0.02, xpd = TRUE)
  title(titre, line = 0.5)
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(1, 1, 2.5, 1), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot_map("grp_raw",  "No transformation")
plot_map("grp_hell", "Hellinger")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1)
```

# 6. Build the analysis tables (Y = fish, X = environment)

Only reaches with a habitat survey and at least one fish can enter the constrained analyses.

```{r build-YX}
env_names <- setdiff(colnames(env), "ReachID")

dat_cc <- full_data %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(env_names), ~ is.finite(.x))) %>%   # complete habitat info
  filter(rowSums(across(all_of(sp_names))) > 0)            # non-empty reaches

Y <- dat_cc[, sp_names];  rownames(Y) <- dat_cc$ReachID
X <- dat_cc[, env_names]; rownames(X) <- dat_cc$ReachID

cat("Reaches used:", nrow(Y), "\n")

# drop rare species (present in < 1 reaches) MODIFIED CODE SO ALL ARE TAKEN NOW Y <- Y[, occ >= 3]
occ <- colSums(Y > 0)
print(occ)
Y <- Y[, occ >= 1]
Y <- Y[rowSums(Y) > 0, ]
X <- X[rownames(Y), ]
cat("Species kept:", ncol(Y), "-", paste(colnames(Y), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# 7. Environmental variables: transform, screen, standardise

```{r env-screen}
# percentages: arcsine-square-root; width: log 
X_t <- X
pc <- grep("^(pct_|sub_)", colnames(X_t), value = TRUE)
X_t[pc] <- lapply(X_t[pc], function(p) asin(sqrt(p / 100)))
X_t$width_mean <- log(X_t$width_mean)
X_t$depth_mean <- log(X_t$depth_mean)

# compositional variables sum to 100 -> drop one meso category
X_t <- X_t %>% select(-any_of("pct_RUN"))

# remove rare substrate classes (mean < 5 %) and constant columns
rare_sub <- grep("^sub_", colnames(X), value = TRUE)
rare_sub <- rare_sub[colMeans(X[rare_sub]) < 5]
X_t <- X_t %>% select(-any_of(rare_sub))
X_t <- X_t[, apply(X_t, 2, sd) > 0, drop = FALSE]

```

```{r plot histograms}
# histograms to check distributions for X (raw)
par(mfrow = c(4, 4), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
for (v in colnames(X)) hist(X[[v]], main = v, xlab = "", col = "steelblue", border = "white")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# histograms to check distributions for X_t (transformed)
par(mfrow = c(4, 4), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
for (v in colnames(X_t)) hist(X_t[[v]], main = v, xlab = "", col = "darkorange", border = "white")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

```

Reading the blue grid (raw) :
- width_mean: most reaches are 2 to 6 m wide, with a right tail up to about 13 m. Mildly right-skewed, so the log   makes sense.
- width_cv: centered around 0.3, one outlier at about 0.8.
- depth_mean: broad, 5 to 25 cm, mode near 8 to 10 cm, slightly right-skewed.
- depth_cv: concentrated at 0.4 to 0.6, with one clear outlier near 1.4. This reach has very uneven depths and may   have high leverage in the analysis.
- MeanTempC: 15 to 21 °C, roughly symmetric, centered around 17.5 °C. Fine as is.
- pct_POOL: 0 to 50%, many reaches with few pools, right-skewed.
- pct_RIFF: 0 to 70%, many reaches with little riffle.
- pct_RUN: 20 to 100%, centered around 55 to 60%. This is the most common mesohabitat.
- sub_BO, sub_CO, sub_GR, sub_SA: the main substrates, fairly spread out and roughly bell-shaped (boulder and sand   0 to 40%, cobble 10 to 45%, gravel 15 to 50%). These carry real information.
- sub_BE, sub_CL, sub_MOSS: one giant bar at 0, almost all reaches have none. They carry essentially no   information.
- sub_SI: mostly 0 to 3%, with a small tail to about 12%.

Reading the orange grid (transformed) :
- width_mean and depth_mean : now in log(m) and more symmetric than the raw version, so the log worked.
- width_cv, depth_mean, depth_cv, MeanTempC: unchanged on purpose. The depth_cv outlier at 1.4 is still there.
- pct_POOL, pct_RIFF, sub_BO, sub_CO, sub_GR, sub_SA: the x axis is now in radians (0 to about 1.57), not %. For - - orientation: 0.2 corresponds to about 4%, 0.5 to about 21%, 0.8 to about 52%, 1.0 to about 71%. The distributions look more bell-shaped than the raw ones, especially pct_POOL and pct_RIFF, which were piled up at  low values before. So the arcsine-square-root helped.
- Remaining small flaws: sub_CO and sub_GR are slightly left-skewed (tail toward low values) after the transform,   but this is mild and acceptable.
